Problem Statement:
Given an array of integers, find the largest element. 
Input Description:
1. The first line contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100).
2. The second line contains n space-separated integers (−10^3 ≤ A[i] ≤ 10^3). 
Output Description:
The program should return the maximum value in the array. 
Sample Input:
5
10 20 5 40 25 
Sample Output:
40
